"""Fig 3 (5 类版). 数据源: DataV 100000_full（含台湾、港澳、南海诸岛 100000_JD）"""
import json
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import geopandas as gpd, pandas as pd

import os
SRC = "data/china_provinces_datav.json"
TAB = "tables/table_3.3_region.csv"
OUT = "figures/fig3_region_map_5class.png"

gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(json.load(open(SRC, encoding="utf-8"))["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")
nine = gdf[gdf["adcode"] == "100000_JD"]
prov = gdf[gdf["adcode"] != "100000_JD"].copy()
prov["name"] = prov["name"].astype(str)

EAST = ["北京市","天津市","河北省","上海市","江苏省","浙江省","福建省","山东省","广东省","海南省","台湾省","香港特别行政区","澳门特别行政区"]
CENTRAL = ["山西省","安徽省","江西省","河南省","湖北省","湖南省"]
WEST = ["内蒙古自治区","广西壮族自治区","重庆市","四川省","贵州省","云南省","西藏自治区","陕西省","甘肃省","青海省","宁夏回族自治区","新疆维吾尔自治区"]
NORTHEAST = ["辽宁省","吉林省","黑龙江省"]
def reg(n):
    return "East" if n in EAST else "Central" if n in CENTRAL else "West" if n in WEST else "Northeast" if n in NORTHEAST else None
prov["region"] = prov["name"].map(reg)
prov = prov.dropna(subset=["region"])
prov["geometry"] = prov["geometry"].simplify(0.05, preserve_topology=True)
ALBERS = "+proj=aea +lat_1=25 +lat_2=47 +lon_0=105 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
prov_alb = prov.to_crs(ALBERS)
regions = prov.dissolve(by="region").reset_index().to_crs(ALBERS)
nine_p = nine.to_crs(ALBERS)
hainan_p = prov[prov["name"] == "海南省"].to_crs(ALBERS)

tab = pd.read_csv(TAB)
K = {"东北":"Northeast","东部":"East","中部":"Central","西部":"West"}
shares = {r["group"]: {K[k]: float(r[k]) for k in K} for _, r in tab.iterrows()}
gp = pd.read_csv("tables/table_3.3_group_profile.csv")
ns = {r["group"]: int(r["n"]) for _, r in gp.iterrows()}
SHORT = {"G1":"low pollution, gradual decline","G2":"moderate pollution, steady decline",
         "G3":"high pollution, partial rebound","G4":"highest pollution, partial rebound",
         "G5":"lowest pollution, steep decline"}

norm = Normalize(0, 80)
import numpy as np
_bp = plt.get_cmap("Blues")
cmap = matplotlib.colors.LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("Blues_trunc", _bp(np.linspace(0, 0.68, 256)))
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 6.2)); fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 3, hspace=0.30, wspace=0.05)
axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[i, j]) for i, j in [(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,1)]]
cax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])

minx, miny, maxx, maxy = regions.total_bounds
POS = {"West": (0.22, 0.55), "Northeast": (0.72, 0.94), "Central": (0.50, 0.40), "East": (0.80, 0.42)}
for ax, g in zip(axes, ["G1","G2","G3","G4","G5"]):
    for _, row in regions.iterrows():
        v = shares[g][row["region"]]
        c = "#F7F7F7" if v == 0 else cmap(norm(v))
        geoms = row.geometry.geoms if row.geometry.geom_type == "MultiPolygon" else [row.geometry]
        for gg in geoms:
            if gg.is_empty: continue
            xs, ys = gg.exterior.xy
            ax.fill(xs, ys, facecolor=c, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.25)
    for _, prow in prov_alb.iterrows():
        pg = prow.geometry
        pgeoms = pg.geoms if pg.geom_type == "MultiPolygon" else [pg]
        for pgg in pgeoms:
            if pgg.is_empty: continue
            pxs, pys = pgg.exterior.xy
            ax.plot(pxs, pys, color="#AAAAAA", linewidth=0.25, zorder=1)
    for rn, (fx, fy) in POS.items():
        _v = shares[g][rn]
        ax.text(fx, fy, f"{rn}\n{_v:.1f}%", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=6.8, color="#777777" if _v == 0 else "#333333",
                linespacing=1.15, path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.6, foreground="white")])
    ax.set_title(f"{g}  (n = {ns[g]:,}, {100*ns[g]/sum(ns.values()):.1f}%)", fontsize=8.5, loc="left", pad=2)
    ax.text(0.0, 1.005, SHORT[g], transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=7, color="#666666", va="bottom")
    ax.set_xlim(minx, maxx); ax.set_ylim(miny, maxy); ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ins = ax.inset_axes([0.73, 0.05, 0.23, 0.25])
    hainan_p.plot(ax=ins, color="#EFEFEF", edgecolor="#999999", linewidth=0.3)
    nine_p.plot(ax=ins, color="#555555", linewidth=0.9)
    ins.text(0.5, -0.08, "South China Sea", transform=ins.transAxes, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.5, color="#666666")
    bx = nine_p.total_bounds
    ins.set_xlim(bx[0]-1e5, bx[2]+1e5); ins.set_ylim(bx[1]-1e5, bx[3]+1e5)
    ins.set_xticks([]); ins.set_yticks([])
    for s in ins.spines.values(): s.set_linewidth(0.4); s.set_color("#999999")

cb = fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm, cmap=cmap), cax=cax, orientation="horizontal")
cb.set_label("Share of class members in the region (%)", fontsize=7.2)
cb.ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
pos = cax.get_position()
cax.set_position([pos.x0 + 0.02, pos.y0 + 0.30, pos.width - 0.06, 0.018])
fig.savefig(OUT, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
print("saved", OUT)

initial_options <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE); file_arg <- initial_options[grep("--file=", initial_options)]; SCRIPTS_DIR <- if (length(file_arg) > 0) normalizePath(dirname(sub("--file=", "", file_arg[1]))) else normalizePath(".")
source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "config.R"))

bl <- read.csv(fp("baseline_5class.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WELCH <- c("age","bmi","sleep_night","nap")
KRUSK <- c("education","self_rated_health","adl_score","depression_cesd",
           "mobility_impairment","metabolic_burden","cardio_cerebrovascular","respiratory_burden")
BIN <- setdiff(VARS, c(WELCH, KRUSK))
grp <- factor(bl$trajectory_group)
p <- sapply(VARS, function(v) {
  x <- bl[[v]]
  if (v %in% WELCH) oneway.test(x ~ grp, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
  else if (v %in% KRUSK) kruskal.test(x ~ grp)$p.value
  else chisq.test(table(x, grp))$p.value
})
padj <- p.adjust(p, method = "bonferroni")
out <- data.frame(variable = LAB[VARS], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (g in 1:5) {
  s <- bl[bl$trajectory_group == g, ]
  out[[paste0("G", g)]] <- sapply(VARS, function(v) {
    x <- s[[v]]
    if (v %in% BIN) sprintf("%d (%.1f)", sum(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
    else sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
}
out$P_adj <- ifelse(padj < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", padj))
out$P_raw <- signif(p, 3)
ns <- sapply(1:5, function(g) sum(bl$trajectory_group == g))
attr(out, "N") <- ns
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(out, file.path(OUT, "table_3.4_baseline_5class.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(data.frame(group = paste0("G", 1:5), N = ns), file.path(OUT, "table_3.4_N.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("significant (Bonferroni<0.05):", sum(padj < 0.05), "/", length(VARS), "\n")

  if (name == "中华人民共和国") {
    return(c("national", "全国"))

    if (nchar(name) == 3) {
      return(c("province", name))

    }
  } else if (grepl("自治区$", name)) {
    return(c("province", name))
  } else if (grepl("市$", name)) {
    return(c("city", name))
  } else if (grepl("州$|盟$|地区$", name)) {

source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "config.R"))

calc_entropy <- function(posterior) {
  ng <- ncol(posterior)
  n  <- nrow(posterior)
  eps <- 1e-16
  p <- pmax(pmin(posterior, 1 - eps), eps)
  1 - sum(-rowSums(p * log(p))) / (n * log(ng))
}

log_msg("============================================================")

  STAGE2$d, STAGE2$scaling, paste(STAGE2$ng_range, collapse=","), STAGE2$n_cores))

cl <- makeCluster(STAGE2$n_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)
clusterExport(cl, c("sim_data", "STAGE2", "DIRS"))

model_results <- foreach(ng = STAGE2$ng_range, .packages = "gbmt") %dopar% {
  start_t <- Sys.time()
  model <- gbmt(
    x.names = c("cog_score", "PM25"),
    unit    = "ID",
    time    = "time",
    d       = STAGE2$d,
    ng      = ng,
    data    = sim_data,
    scaling = STAGE2$scaling,
    pruning = STAGE2$pruning
  )
  run_time <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_t, units = "secs")), 2)
  rds_path <- file.path(DIRS$models, sprintf("gbmtm_ng%d.rds", ng))
  saveRDS(model, rds_path)
  list(ng = ng, run_time = run_time,
       aic = round(AIC(model), 2), bic = round(BIC(model), 2), model = model)
}

  ng <- res$ng; mod <- res$model
  post <- mod$posterior

    ng = ng, AIC = res$aic, BIC = res$bic,
    entropy = ek, APPA_mean = appa_m,
    min_group_prop = min_prop,
    converged = as.integer(conv),
    iterations = nrow(mod$em),
    run_time_sec = res$run_time,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  log_msg(sprintf("   ng=%d AIC=%.1f BIC=%.1f Ek=%.4f APPA=%.4f conv=%d",
    ng, res$aic, res$bic, ek, appa_m, as.integer(conv)))
}
compare_table <- do.call(rbind, compare_list)

log_msg("4. 模型选择...")
conv_models <- compare_table[compare_table$converged == 1, ]
stopifnot(nrow(conv_models) > 0)
best_idx <- which.min(conv_models$BIC)
best_ng  <- conv_models$ng[best_idx]
log_msg(sprintf("   最低 BIC: ng=%d", best_ng))

if (conv_models$entropy[best_idx] < sel$min_entropy ||
    conv_models$APPA_mean[best_idx] < sel$min_appa ||
    conv_models$min_group_prop[best_idx] < sel$min_group_prop) {
  for (i in order(conv_models$ng, decreasing = TRUE)) {
    r <- conv_models[i, ]
    if (r$entropy >= sel$min_entropy &&
        r$APPA_mean >= sel$min_appa &&
        r$min_group_prop >= sel$min_group_prop) {
      best_ng <- r$ng
      log_msg(sprintf("   >> 降级至 ng=%d", best_ng))
      break
    }
  }
}

best_model <- model_results[[which(sapply(model_results, `[[`, "ng") == best_ng)]]$model

  group_stats$cog_slope[g]  <- fit[nrow(fit), 1] - fit[1, 1]
  group_stats$mean_cog[g]   <- mean(fit[, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
}

group_stats$new_label  <- rank(group_stats$risk_score, ties.method = "first")

}

for (v in mice_vars) log_msg(sprintf("  %-30s %5.1f%%", label_var(v), miss_pct[v]))

  if (v == "region") {
    meth[v] <- "polyreg"

merged$sig_lost   <- merged$sig_main & !merged$significant
merged$sig_gained <- !merged$sig_main & merged$significant
n_dir <- sum(merged$direction_change); n_lost <- sum(merged$sig_lost); n_gain <- sum(merged$sig_gained)
log_msg(sprintf("  Direction changes: %d, Sig lost: %d, Sig gained: %d (Bonferroni-matched)", n_dir, n_lost, n_gain))
write.csv(merged, file.path(DIRS$tables, "sensitivity_pp_filter.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

qa <- c("# Stage 3E QA: Sensitivity Analysis [Sandbox]",
        "", paste0("**Time**: ", format(Sys.time())),
        paste0("**Filter**: pp>=0.70, ", n_filt, "/", n_full),
        paste0("**Filtered VIF>5**: ", nrow(high_vif_f)),
        paste0("**Filtered M3 sig (Bonferroni)**: ", sum(sens_df$significant), "/", nrow(sens_df)),
        paste0("**Main M3 sig (Bonferroni)**: ", sum(merged$sig_main), "/", nrow(merged)),
        "", sprintf("Direction changes: %d", n_dir),
        sprintf("Sig lost: %d", n_lost),
        sprintf("Sig gained: %d", n_gain),
        "",
        "判定标准：与主分析同口径（Bonferroni，72 检验）。",
        "灵敏性子样本更小，部分主分析显著项跌出阈值属预期；关键判据为",
        "方向是否反转、以及是否出现主分析中不存在的新显著项。",
        "",
        if (n_dir == 0 && n_gain == 0)
          "### Conclusion: STABLE (no direction reversal, no new significance)"
        else "### Needs review")
writeLines(qa, file.path(DIRS$qc_reports, "stage3e_sensitivity_qc.md"))
log_msg("Stage 3E [Sandbox] complete")

# Code for: Joint Developmental Trajectories of Cognitive Function and PM2.5 Exposure Among Middle-Aged and Older Adults in China

Reproducible analysis code for the manuscript. The pipeline links four waves of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS; 2011, 2013, 2015, 2018) with city-level annual PM2.5 estimates from the CHAP dataset, fits group-based multi-trajectory models (GBMTM) jointly on cognitive score and PM2.5 exposure, and profiles the resulting trajectory groups with multinomial logistic regression.

## Data

Participant-level data are not distributed in this repository.

- CHARLS survey data: https://charls.pku.edu.cn (registration and data-use agreement required; participant-level data cannot be redistributed).
- CHAP PM2.5 dataset: https://data.tpdc.ac.cn (Wei et al. 2021, Remote Sensing of Environment 252, 112136).
- Province boundaries for Figure 3 (download to `data/china_provinces_datav.json`): https://geo.datav.aliyun.com/areas_v3/bound/100000_full.json

Place the required CHARLS files under `data/charls/` following the layout expected by `R/config.R` (see the `PATHS` list), and the merged city-year PM2.5 file at `data/pollution.xlsx`. Environment variables `CHARLS_DIR` and `POLLUTION_FILE` can override these locations.

## Requirements

- R (4.5+) with packages: `gbmt`, `doParallel`, `foreach`, `dplyr`, `mice`, `nnet`, `haven`, `ggplot2`
- Python 3 with `pandas`, `geopandas`, `matplotlib` (regional map figure only)

## Pipeline

Run order (scripts in `R/`):

| Script | Output | Manuscript element |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `run_stage1.R` | `trajectory_long.csv` | cohort construction (age >= 45, >= 3 valid waves on both indicators) |
| `run_stage2.R` | `model_comparison.csv`, `gbmtm_ng{2..6}.rds`, `final_trajectory_assignment.csv`, `group_reordering.csv` | Table 1; group labels G1-G5 ordered by z(mean PM2.5) - z(cognitive change) |
| `run_descriptives.R` | sample and wave trend tables | Section 3.1 |
| `run_group_profile.R` | group profile table | Section 3.3 (class sizes, mean PM2.5, fitted trajectories) |
| `run_regional.R` | region composition table | Section 3.3 (four economic regions) |
| `run_stage3a_baseline.R` / `run_stage3a_add_region.R` | baseline table with Bonferroni-corrected tests | Table 2 |
| `run_stage3c.R` | missingness assessment, MICE (m = 10), imputation density figure | Section 3.4, Figure S1 |
| `run_stage3d.R` | multinomial logistic models 1-3, forest plot | Section 3.5, Figure 4, Table S2 |
| `run_stage3e.R` | sensitivity analysis in the high-confidence subsample (posterior probability >= 0.70) | Section 3.6 |
| `python/fig_map_5class.py` | regional choropleth figure | Figure 3 |

A single sweep is reproduced by running the scripts in the order above with `Rscript`; shared settings (seed = 2026, reference group, variable lists) live in `R/config.R`.

## Notes

- Fixed seed (2026) is set in `R/config.R`; EM starting values follow the defaults of the `gbmt` package.
- Model selection criteria: BIC comparison plus minimum classification-quality thresholds (entropy >= 0.70, APPA >= 0.70, smallest class >= 10%), implemented in `run_stage2.R`.
- The group-ordering rule and the region mapping of provinces follow the definitions described in the Methods section of the manuscript.
